The content on the Thurston County website is currently provided in English. We are providing the “Translation” for approximately 10 languages. The goal of the translation is to provide visitors with limited English proficiency to access information on the website in other languages. The translations do not translate all types of documents, and it may not give you an exact translation all the time. The translations are made through an automated process, which may not result in accurate or precise translations, particularly of technical and legal terminology.

Meetings and Agendas

Meetings and Agendas

Meeting Locations: All regular Board of County Commissioners, Board of Health, and Transportation Benefit District meetings will be held at the Thurston County Atrium: 3000 Pacific Ave SE, Room 110, Olympia, WA 98501. The location of any other meeting will be noticed on the agenda.

Virtual Attendance: The Zoom registration link will be linked below for meetings with the option to join virtually.

Public Comment: Written public comment may be submitted up to two hours prior to the start time of a meeting.  Any public comment received by that time will be distributed to the Board conducting the meeting prior to the start time. Written public comment received after that time, will be processed and distributed after the conclusion of the meeting. Written public comment may be submitted in person or emailed to the Clerk of the Board conducting the meeting, or mailed in. Verbal public comment is accepted only during BoCC and BoH meetings when noted on an agenda for a meeting. Verbal public comment can be provided in person or via Zoom.

Disability Accommodations

Thurston County is committed to ensuring all people have equal access to county services and programs. We seek to accommodate the needs of the public in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act and Washington Law Against Discrimination.

Room 110 is equipped with an assistive listening system and is wheelchair accessible. To request a disability accommodation for a meeting or hearing, contact the Reasonable Accommodation Coordinator at 360-786-5440. Persons with speech or hearing disabilities may call via Washington Relay: 711 or 800-833-6388.
